name: Organisation of African, Caribbean and Pacific States (until 2013)
description: A white field charged with the ACP emblem: the letters 'acp' outlined in green, each enclosing an orange globe marked with lines of latitude and longitude.
history: The emblem of the African, Caribbean and Pacific Group of States dates from the Georgetown Agreement of 1975; the flag bearing it was replaced on 17 June 2013 in Brussels by the diagonal green, gold and blue design.

features.role: the letters 'acp' each holding an orange globe
